comment: Fixed 7-turn persona for the before/after warmth measurement (docs/PLAN-guaranteed-reply-text.md). Deliberately heavy on routine answers — numerics, negations — where the graded-every-answer voice shows most. Keep this file stable so runs stay comparable.
messages: Hey — I'm Sam. Want to drop some weight, I've been out of the gym for a couple of years.
I lifted for years before that, I'd say I'm intermediate. There's a full gym at my office.
Monday, Wednesday and Friday work. About 45 minutes realistically.
Desk job mostly. No injuries, nothing I avoid.
No dietary restrictions, I eat pretty much anything. Three meals a day, no snacks.
